context.transcript:
Good morning.
Welcome to the City Water Department's new-employee workshop.
This morning, I'll be demonstrating the use of our specialized apparatus to test water for sodium and other mineral components.
Although the workshop will take place here in our laboratory, I'll also demonstrate how the equipment can test water at a project site.
It is surprisingly simple to use, which is a big advantage in the field.
At the end of the session, you'll receive a certificate of completion to show that you're qualified in the use of the equipment.
context.transcript_translation:
早上好。
欢迎来到City Water Department的新员工培训班。
今天上午，我将演示使用我们的专业设备来检测水中的钠和其他矿物质成分。
虽然这次培训将在我们实验室进行，但我也会演示该设备如何在项目现场检测水质。
它非常简单易用，这是在野外的一个很大优势。
在课程结束时，您会收到一份结业证书，证明您具备使用该设备的资格。
